remarks: Are you looking for your own mini estate in Pendleton?  We have it! It's the Cobblestone on Bear Ridge Road with all of the "I wants" you can imagine. A home with charm and character, updated, modern kitchen and baths, space to entertain family and friends, beautiful views perched at the top of the Ridge.  This 3-bedroom home features a spacious and well-appointed kitchen. It includes all Bosch appliances; French door refrigerator, gas stove and hood, dishwasher and Moen fixtures. There is an abundance of gorgeous granite countertop and a powered, center island.The hardwood floors add to the charm here along with the Dutch door to the front flagstone entry. The eating area is an endless stretch that runs from the kitchen through to the family room; this space could fit even the largest of gatherings. If that's not enough, there is a formal dining/living room with pegged hardwood floors off to the other side of the kitchen. The family room is highlighted by cathedral, beamed ceilings, abundant natural light, a gas stove (NRTC) for chilly evenings and French doors that lead to a huge sunroom; added in 1998, it sits high above the driveway, the garage and the pool.  While relaxing in this room, you feel like you are in a treehouse. The 1st floor also offers an ensuite. The bedroom is a showstopper with hardwood floors, transom windows, built-in corner storage and access to a private bath featuring ceramic tile floors, double bowl sink, soaking tub, glass enclosed shower stall and private commode room with pocket door. Upstairs offers two more large bedrooms with Jack and Jill bath and large, walk in closet. The partially finished basement with walkout, exposed log ceilings, gas fireplace, fruit cellar and a bar.  Moving to the outdoor features of this beauty, the first thing you will notice are the perennials that dot the landscape.  The detached garage has a wall of windows repurposed from the home.  This space has a woodburning fireplace and doubles as entertaining area, additional storage areas and separate shed. The 20x40' inground pool will provide endless days of fun in the sun.  There is a pool house and bus stop too.  Come take a look!
